notes.title: Inn Keeper Closed Beta - v0.0.1.4
notes.content:
Additions

 Added the possibility of setting vertical synchronization (V-Sync)
 Added screen mode settings (fullscreen, windowed fullscreen and windowed)
 Added the ability to set frame rate limit (maximum number of FPS in game)
 Added crafting system (available crafts can be consulted in the tooltip of each item)
 EXPERIMENTAL: added a water source on the map (visual only)
 Added a "World map" build to view the world map and important locations
 Added "Water" item
 Added Christmas event items


Changes

 Changed display of social network interfaces
 Modification of all user interfaces to make them more readable and consistent
 Optimization of certain elements of the map


Fixes

 Fixed item decomposition, which was not working properly
 Fixed character death, which was blocking the game
 Fixed some item properties to prevent unforeseen interactions
 Various bug fixes

notes.title: Inn Keeper Closed Beta - v0.0.1.3
notes.content:
Additions

 Added keyboard shortcuts for the target entity under the cursor
 Added shadow to common vegetation (grasses and flowers)
 Added an offset when an item is spawned to avoid abrupt spawns in certain circumstances
 Added candle to debug menu


Changes

 The default number of hotbar slots is now 3 instead of 2
 Improved customer waiting times
 When an item from a customer's order is given to him, the customer's waiting time will increase according to the rarity of the item
 Change the interface when the cursor is hovered over a piece of furniture
 Significant improvement in item collision (items should no longer be able to pass through the floor when thrown or moved, for example)
 Significant optimization of light performance
 Various minor fixes and improvements including, but not limited to, collisions and entity properties
 Improved slot visibility when selected
 Improved item icon quality
 Changes to various interfaces to improve readability and overall consistency


Fixes

 Fixed the game's logo, which did not have smooth edges
 Fixed stone foundations that made no noise when stepped on
 Fixed a bug that did not destroy the floating interface of furniture when moved under certain circumstances

notes.title: Inn Keeper Closed Beta - v0.0.1.2
notes.content:
Additions

 Added the brown ale which was missing


Changes

 Improved inventory interface refresh reliability when inventory or hotbar contents are modified
 Improved reliability of drag-and-drop operation in inventory
 Change the display of an item during a drag-and-drop operation
 Improved interface when an item is pointed under the cursor
 Balanced stamina consumption and use, especially for movement actions
 Reduced cursor size and opacity
 The game now pauses when the "quit" menu is opened
 Improved item physics when moving over them
 Optimized navigable surface for AIs


Fixes

 Fixed and improved collisions of some furniture and items

notes.title: Inn Keeper Closed Beta - v0.0.1.1
notes.content:
Additions

 Added vegetables missing from the inn's storage room
 Added footsteps to customers
 Added sound attenuation for footsteps


Changes

 Main menu music now plays in loop


Fixes

 Fixed the preview interface, which only displayed a question mark when an item was dragged and dropped
 Fixed inventory load text that did not update correctly
 Fixed the blood sausage that turned into pork sausage when put down
